frozen_laws.text: PIT basis vocabulary per feature: pit_live | recomputed_history | vintage | current_snapshot_backfill | display_only.
Forward outcomes may never be encoder inputs; evaluation labels only.

Latent clusters remain unnamed until stable across two consecutive quarterly refits, where stable means cluster-membership Jaccard >= 0.8 on the overlapping window. Named or not, clusters are display-only and may never gate, rank, size, or escalate.
Era-composition disclosure: any cluster whose membership is >80% one coverage era is reported as an era detector, not a state — printed in the model card.
Model card + eval.json mandatory at first emit; no return-prediction headline at birth.

reopen_conditions.condition_a: The kernel has real quad-conditioned cells for >= 3 engines with n_eff >= 30 each via forward accrual.
reopen_conditions.condition_a_prime: The kernel program adopts recomputed_history quad backfill (printed caveat) giving the conditioning baseline.
reopen_conditions.condition_b: At least one kernel decision batch has run (first due 2026-10-01). Both condition (a or a') and condition (b) must hold.

features.label: quad label (recomputed-history)
features.description: Quad growth/inflation label (Q1-Q4) from the PIT re-run spine. The only long-running daily quad series (1971+) available without look-ahead, but recomputed from current code, not a true vintage.
features.pit_basis_note: Single vintage_store_asof = 2026-06-25 for the entire history; five macro legs used revision-aware vintages (FRED vintage store) but code/model was fixed at current version. Not a rolling-release tape.
features.revision_basis: Full rebuild on script run; history is rewritten each time. Not append-only.
features.leakage_risk_reason: PIT FRED vintages used for revision-leaky macro legs; market-priced legs are unrevised by construction. Main risk: code-vintage gap (future regime logic applied to past data).
features.null_policy: Null for dates before 1971-01-04 or if the vintage store is absent. An encoder must mask these rows.

features.label: regime confidence
features.description: Model confidence in the current quad assignment from regime_v2_pit.
features.pit_basis_note: Same single-vintage rebuild as rmc_001.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Derived from same PIT-aware quad classification.
features.null_policy: Null before 1971; mask same as rmc_001.

features.label: transition state
features.description: Binary flip-in-progress flag from regime_v2_pit (transition_state). Ratcheted transition logic.
features.pit_basis_note: Same single-vintage rebuild.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Transition detection logic is applied retroactively; true transitions were not known in advance with the exact same confidence windows.
features.null_policy: Null before 1971; mask with rmc_001 coverage.

features.label: growth score
features.description: Continuous growth factor score (signed) from regime_v2_pit. Underlying component of quad.
features.pit_basis_note: Sparse early history; growth_score is null for many pre-1980 rows due to missing macro leg inputs.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Same PIT framework as rmc_001.
features.null_policy: Null when macro legs unavailable (frequent pre-1980). An encoder must treat nulls as missing-data mask, not zero.

features.label: inflation score
features.description: Continuous inflation factor score from regime_v2_pit.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as rmc_004.
features.leakage_risk_reason: PIT framework applies.
features.null_policy: Null when inflation leg inputs unavailable. Mask same as rmc_004.

features.label: liquidity overlay
features.description: Binary liquidity state from regime/latest.json. Live daily. Not a long history.
features.pit_basis_note: latest.json is a current snapshot. For backtesting, the liquidity_overlay field is also present in regime_history.parquet (which runs from 1971 but uses current code logic, making it recomputed_history for training). Assigned current_snapshot_backfill because the nightly append-only regime_history.parquet is what a backtest would use, and that history was not stamped PIT-live.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Liquidity overlay uses real-time data constructs applied retroactively in regime_history.
features.null_policy: Null if artifact is stale. In regime_history backfill, nulls indicate the field was not yet computed for early dates.

features.label: vol regime
features.description: Volatility regime state (e.g. low/elevated/stress) from regime_v2_pit and world_state. Available in regime_history.parquet back to 1971.
features.pit_basis_note: From regime_v2_pit rebuild; vol_regime as a standalone field lives in regime_vector (current_snapshot_backfill, 2026-07 only) — the historical analogue is regime flags.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Flag fields may use smoothed or retrospectively-fitted thresholds.
features.null_policy: Null before regime_v2_pit coverage (pre-1971).

features.label: recession flag
features.description: Binary recession flag from regime_v2_pit.
features.pit_basis_note: NBER recession dates are PIT by publication date, but the mapping to daily rows uses current vintage.
features.leakage_risk_reason: NBER dates are essentially fixed post-announcement; main risk is announcement lag (~6-12 months after trough).
features.null_policy: Null before 1971.

features.label: Fed net liquidity
features.description: WALCL minus RRP minus TGA (Fed balance sheet net liquidity). Weekly frequency, daily interpolated.
features.pit_basis_note: WALCL/RRP/TGA are published on H.4.1 (weekly Wednesdays) with no revision. The expanding percentile is computed from history available at each date.
features.revision_basis: WALCL/RRP/TGA data is not revised materially; percentile recomputed each day on expanding window.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Published public data; weekly cadence means no intraday future look-ahead.
features.null_policy: Null before 2002-12-18. An encoder must mask or treat this as a late-start feature with 2002-era confound.

features.label: market state verdict
features.description: Current market state verdict from market_state/latest.json (e.g. risk_on / risk_off / fragile).
features.pit_basis_note: latest.json is a current-day snapshot. Forward log (data/market_state/forward_log.jsonl) extends the history, but it is a rolling append begun when the feature was deployed — not a full PIT backfill. Classifying as current_snapshot_backfill because long-history training would require a recomputed_history run not yet performed.
features.revision_basis: Rebuilt nightly. forward_log appends without revision.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Score methodology uses real-time risk_radar and regime inputs; applying today's code to historical dates would be a look-ahead on regime state.
features.null_policy: Null for dates before forward_log deployment. An encoder must not use the backfilled label prior to live deployment date.

features.label: risk radar state
features.description: Risk radar dominant scare and escalation state from regime/latest.json risk_radar block.
features.pit_basis_note: risk_radar in latest.json is the current snapshot. The risk-radar-forward-log (data/risk_radar/forward_log.jsonl) provides a PIT append-only record from deployment forward; pre-deployment history would require a full recompute.
features.revision_basis: Rebuilt nightly; forward_log appends without revision.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Risk radar aggregates multiple contemporaneous signals; any look-back window in the scare scoring could embed future-available information if history is recomputed.
features.null_policy: Null before forward_log deployment. Do not use recomputed history as if it were PIT.

features.label: inflation shock flag
features.description: Binary inflation shock flag from regime_v2_pit.
features.pit_basis_note: Same single-vintage rebuild.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Uses same PIT framework as quad.
features.null_policy: Null before 1971.

features.label: daily claim count (all engines)
features.description: Number of claims fired on each as_of date across all engines, aggregated from spine_index. A density feature, not a directional signal.
features.pit_basis_note: spine_index is a full daily rebuild (IDEMPOTENT FULL REBUILD per synapse notes). It unions multiple ledgers, some of which are themselves PIT-live (track_record fires) and some of which are recomputed. The spine itself does not preserve what a real-time aggregation would have seen on a given day.
features.revision_basis: Full rebuild nightly. History can change if source ledgers change.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Count features carry no directional look-ahead; the claim fires themselves are graded with as_of dates. Density only — not using outcome columns.
features.null_policy: Zero count (not null) for dates with no claims. Sparse pre-1990.

features.label: claim count by engine family
features.description: Per-engine-family claim fire counts: track_record, radar, altdata, desk:ai_desk, us_board, options_entry, policy, reflexes.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as scd_001. Most engine families only have data from 2021+ (altdata, desk, options_entry). track_record is the deep archive (1962+).
features.leakage_risk_reason: Count features only.
features.null_policy: Zero for families not active on a given date. Note: mixing 1962-era track_record density with 2021-era options/altdata density creates era confound per frozen law 4.

features.label: directional balance (bull/bear ratio)
features.description: Ratio of direction=+1 to direction=-1 claims per day across the spine. Captures whether the system is net-bullish or net-bearish on a given date.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as scd_001.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Directional balance is a contemporaneous count; no outcome data used.
features.null_policy: Null when no claims fired. Use with era-confound caveat: pre-2021 spine has only track_record + radar + policy claims.

features.label: role distribution (alpha / timing / context / veto / sizing)
features.description: Count and share of claims by role flag (is_alpha, is_timing, is_context, is_veto, is_sizing) per date.
features.pit_basis_note: Role flags are assigned at registration time but backfilled for historical claims by the current spine rebuild. Not a true PIT role assignment.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Role flag backfill uses current taxonomy; early claims may have been reclassified relative to what was known at fire time.
features.null_policy: False/zero for unset flags. Flag coverage sparse pre-2021.

features.label: quad context at fire time
features.description: Distribution of quad labels stamped on claims as they fired (quad_hard_label). Captures what regime the system was in when claims accumulated.
features.pit_basis_note: quad_hard_label in spine_index is stamped at rebuild time using current regime code, not the regime that was live when the claim fired. Consistent with regime-v2-pit class.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Regime labels applied retroactively to historical claims; do not confuse with contemporaneous regime awareness.
features.null_policy: Null for claims where regime was not determinable. Common pre-1971.

features.label: horizon distribution
features.description: Distribution of claim horizons (e.g. share of 10d vs 21d vs 63d horizon claims) per date.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as scd_001.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Horizon is a structural property of each claim type, not a forward-looking label.
features.null_policy: Zero for missing horizons. Short-horizon claims (< 21d) are absent from early spine.

features.label: scope-type distribution (index / sector / ticker / macro)
features.description: Share of claims by scope_type per date. Contextual signal for how claims are scoped.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as scd_001.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Scope type is structural.
features.null_policy: Null for claims with missing scope. Pre-2010 spine is primarily index/macro scope.

features.label: reflex and cortex-attention fire rate
features.description: Count of reflex and cortex_attention firings in the spine per date. Captures NW self-monitoring activity.
features.pit_basis_note: Reflex firings are append-only JSONL (single-writer per reflex); cortex_attention is also append-only. These are genuinely PIT-live records. But firings only exist from late 2025/2026 when the reflex system was deployed.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Append-only, single-writer, no forward information.
features.null_policy: Zero / no rows for dates before reflex deployment (approximately 2026). Feature effectively unavailable for historical backtesting.

features.label: falsifier flag density
features.description: Share of claims with falsifier flag set per date. Indicates proportion of testable vs structural claims.
features.pit_basis_note: falsifier flag was assigned retroactively at registration; pre-registration history is sparse.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Binary flag, no outcome information.
features.null_policy: Null / zero pre-2021 for most engines. Treat as late-start feature.

features.label: archetype distribution at fire time
features.description: Distribution of archetype labels stamped on spine claims per date (e.g. growth, value, defensive). Structural context only.
features.pit_basis_note: Archetype labels come from archetypes/history.parquet which covers 2009+; earlier spine rows will have null archetype. Archetype history was built on-demand (not nightly) so is effectively a single-vintage recompute.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Archetype assignments use current fundamental data plus historical financials; may embed data not available at the original fire date.
features.null_policy: Null pre-2009. Sparse 2009-2015 for small/mid-caps.

features.label: forward-outcome labels (EXCLUDED — evaluation only)
features.description: outcome_excess, outcome_graded, fwd_mfe_5, fwd_mfe_10, fwd_mfe_21, fwd_mfe_63, fwd_mfe_126 from spine_index. These are EVALUATION LABELS and must never be encoder inputs per frozen law 2.
features.pit_basis_note: These are post-hoc graded outcomes using realized prices.
features.leakage_risk_reason: These are future-realized outcomes. Encoding them would be direct future look-ahead.
features.null_policy: N/A — excluded from encoder.
features.excluded_reason: Frozen law 2: forward outcomes are evaluation labels only, never encoder inputs.

features.label: per-engine n_eff
features.description: Effective sample count per engine/regime/horizon cell in the kernel. Captures how much evidence underlies each reliability estimate.
features.pit_basis_note: kernel_estimates.parquet is rebuilt nightly as a derived view of spine_index. Only 22 rows exist (22 cells with __all__/__unstamped__ buckets; no real quad-conditioned cells yet). No historical series of kernel estimates exists — only today's snapshot. Assigning current_snapshot_backfill because any backtest would need a recomputed-history series of kernel estimates that does not yet exist.
features.revision_basis: Full rebuild nightly. History is not tracked.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Each nightly rebuild incorporates all spine history to date; using today's kernel estimates as a feature on historical dates would embed n_eff levels not known at that time.
features.null_policy: Null for any engine/regime/horizon combination not in the 22 cells. An encoder must represent sparse kernel as missing, not zero.

features.label: shrunken IC per engine
features.description: Hierarchically-shrunken information coefficient per engine cell. Wilson CI lower bound for reliability.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as krc_001.
features.leakage_risk_reason: shrunken_ic is estimated from all historical spine data available at build time; using it as a feature at historical dates embeds total-history information.
features.null_policy: Null for cells not in current 22-row kernel. Treat as 'unknown reliability' missing category.

features.label: armed flag per engine family
features.description: Binary flag: whether a given engine family has met the minimum reliability bar for display use. From both kernel_estimates and kernel_families.
features.pit_basis_note: kernel_families.json is rebuilt nightly as a derived view. No historical series of armed flags exists.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Armed status embeds cumulative spine history. Same concern as krc_001.
features.null_policy: Null for families not in current 6-family set. Use conservative 'not armed' class.

features.label: horizon decay curve shape
features.description: Per-engine horizon decay profile: shrunken_ic at each horizon (from kernel_families). Captures whether a family's reliability degrades quickly or slowly with horizon.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as krc_003.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Decay curve is fitted from full history available at build time.
features.null_policy: Null for families with fewer than curve_floor=3 horizon cells. All-null is a legitimate outcome.

features.label: date_last fire per engine
features.description: Most recent claim fire date per engine family. Indicates staleness / recency of evidence.
features.pit_basis_note: date_last is the most recent as_of in spine_index for that engine as of the last rebuild.
features.leakage_risk_reason: A date is not a future-looking value. But using today's date_last as a historical feature is technically a snapshot value.
features.null_policy: Null for engines with no fires in spine.

features.label: measured half-life per engine family
features.description: Fitted holding-horizon half-life per engine family. All families null in current run (non-decaying curves). Structural context only.
features.pit_basis_note: half_life.json is built from kernel_estimates + spine_index as a nightly snapshot. The monotone-decrease gate causes all families to emit null in the current run (status=fit_ran, all half_lives null).
features.leakage_risk_reason: Null output at present; when non-null, the half-life estimate is based on observed IC-decay which is a backward-looking measure.
features.null_policy: Currently all null. An encoder should include as a masked feature to be populated when decay is measured.

features.label: lagging signal flags
features.description: Per-date flags from lagging_signals.json: fired_in_hostile_regime, fired_breadth_unconfirmed, repeat_fire. Captures how many recently-fired claims show warning signs.
features.pit_basis_note: lagging_signals.json is a current-day snapshot. No long history exists. The underlying logic uses trailing-63d spine data, making it a rolling current-snapshot feature.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Uses trailing-63d lookback from current date; no forward information.
features.null_policy: Null / unavailable before the lagging signals feature was deployed. Use as late-start feature.

features.label: kernel decision batch outcomes
features.description: Results of the formal kernel decision batch runs from kernel_decisions.json. Captures whether families were promoted or killed.
features.pit_basis_note: On-demand artifact. Freshness_sla=9999h (effectively static until next decision batch). First batch due 2026-10-01.
features.revision_basis: On-demand only. Append per decision batch run.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Decision outcomes are determined at a specific point in time and not revised.
features.null_policy: No decisions have been made yet (artifact exists but has no promotion/kill entries). Treat as all-null until first batch.

features.label: covariance spine — independent lobe count
features.description: Number of effectively-independent lobes from covariance_spine.json. Structural context on how much genuine diversification the NW signal set provides.
features.pit_basis_note: covariance_spine_history.parquet exists but has only 1 row (2026-07-06). No historical series available. Daily-built but history starts at deployment date.
features.revision_basis: Rebuilt daily; history accumulates in covariance_spine_history.parquet (append).
features.leakage_risk_reason: Independence measure is based on contemporaneous correlation, not forward returns.
features.null_policy: Null before 2026-07-06. Feature effectively unavailable for historical backtesting.

features.label: total node count in confluence graph
features.description: Number of nodes in the confluence_graph.json. Structural count of active NW entities.
features.pit_basis_note: confluence_graph.json is rebuilt nightly. No history parquet exists for node/edge counts. Currently 148 nodes, 749 edges.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Count of structural artifacts has no forward-return information.
features.null_policy: Null before confluence was deployed. Use as late-start feature.

features.label: edge count by type (feeds / confirms / contradicts / leads)
features.description: Number of edges of each type in the confluence graph. Captures how structurally connected vs evidentially supported the NW is.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as cct_001.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Structural edge count, no return information.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment. Confirms/leads/contradicts edges are sparse (most edges are structural feeds).

features.label: contradiction count and severity
features.description: Total contradictions and breakdown by severity from confluence_graph contradiction_summary block. Captures how much the NW's signal set is currently in conflict.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as cct_001.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Contradiction flags are based on contemporaneous signal state; no future return embedded.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment. Zero contradictions is a legitimate state.

features.label: independence summary from covariance spine
features.description: The lobe-independence / same-bet-warning block embedded in covariance_spine.json. Captures whether current NW signal state is heavily correlated.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as krc_009.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Contemporaneous independence measure.
features.null_policy: Null before 2026-07-06. Late-start feature only.

features.label: world state contradiction count
features.description: Number of active contradictions in world_state.json contradictions block (n, by_severity).
features.pit_basis_note: world_state.json is rebuilt nightly. No history artifact. Contradiction detector computes contemporaneous 6-pair cross-checks.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Contemporaneous contradiction detection.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment. Zero is a legitimate state.

features.label: DT contra state
features.description: DannyTrades-style contradiction state from dt_contra_state.json: universe_n, n_with_chip, counts_by_state, counts_by_band. Descriptive-only divergence signal across stocks.
features.pit_basis_note: Daily rebuild; no history parquet. Descriptive-only per charter (DT-contra display_only).
features.leakage_risk_reason: Count distribution across current stock states; no forward information.
features.null_policy: Null before dt_contra deployment. Use as late-start feature.

features.label: reflexivity N_eff history
features.description: Rolling N_eff from the reflexivity overlay — how many independent observations underlie the current reflexivity estimate.
features.pit_basis_note: Append-only history JSON; each entry is stamped as_of its compute date. Genuinely PIT-live but deployed recently (2025/2026).
features.revision_basis: Append-only. Past entries are not revised.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Append-only PIT record.
features.null_policy: Null/empty before deployment. Very short history currently.

features.label: factor contradiction ledger fire rate
features.description: Rate of factor-contradiction firings from factor_contradictions.jsonl. Captures how often factor NW detects internal contradictions. NOTE: artifact not present locally — may be R2-managed or pending first fires.
features.pit_basis_note: Append-only JSONL per synapse; genuinely PIT-live. But artifact not present locally (0 files). May be empty (no contradictions yet) or gitignored.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Append-only PIT record.
features.null_policy: Treat as zero fire rate if absent. Absence = no detected contradictions, not a missing-data gap.

features.label: world state breadth divergence
features.description: breadth_div field from world_state.json breadth block — captures when breadth and price are diverging.
features.pit_basis_note: world_state.json is current snapshot. breadth_div is computed from breadth.parquet which has history back to 1962 — but the world_state assembly of breadth_div is a nightly snapshot with no history file.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Breadth divergence is a contemporaneous measure.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment. The underlying breadth.parquet could support a historical reconstruction but the world_state composition has not been backfilled.

features.label: cycle phase distribution (monthly)
features.description: Phase distribution across tracked cycle entities from state_monthly.parquet. Captures where the cycle ensemble sits (early/mid/late/bear).
features.pit_basis_note: state_monthly.parquet is built on-demand (cadence: on-demand) from cycle pattern detection code. It is a full rebuild from source data rather than a running PIT tape. The cycle patterns themselves are fitted to historical price data using current code.
features.revision_basis: Full rebuild on-demand. History can change when pattern code is updated.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Cycle patterns are fit retrospectively; a detected pattern in 2012 may have been identified using future-available data if the pattern-fitting window extended beyond 2012.
features.null_policy: Null before 2010-12-31 (start of state_monthly history). Small entity set initially.

features.label: live cycle hazard probabilities (1m/3m/6m)
features.description: Per-entity hazard probabilities (hazard_1m_p, hazard_3m_p, hazard_6m_p) from state_daily_live.parquet. Captures forward-drawdown risk context per tracked entity.
features.pit_basis_note: state_daily_live is built nightly from live pattern states. The hazard probabilities come from a hazard model trained on historical data (recomputed_history for the model itself) but the daily scoring is applied live going forward. Current local data shows 6 distinct dates (2026-06-26, 2026-06-30, 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-05, excluding weekends). For backtesting, the state_monthly parquet provides a longer history for phase/position but not the hazard probability series.
features.revision_basis: Rebuilt nightly. Only most-recent row per entity in live store.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Hazard model trained on historical realized drawdowns; backcast hazard probabilities would be recomputed_history, not pit_live.
features.null_policy: NaN when hazard model not applicable to an entity. For backtesting, the live hazard series is too short; use state_monthly phase as proxy.

features.label: cycle pattern state JSON summary
features.description: Compact cycle state from cycle_pattern_state.json: gate_status, truth_summary, phase distribution across entities.
features.pit_basis_note: Current-snapshot nightly rebuild. No history file for this JSON summary artifact.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Phase states derived from pattern detection on historical data.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment. Use state_monthly as historical proxy.

features.label: cycle pattern phase diversity
features.description: Entropy or standard deviation of phase_v2 distribution across all cycle entities. High diversity = mixed cycle ensemble; low diversity = regime coherence.
features.pit_basis_note: Derived from state_daily_live. Same caveat as chc_002.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Phase diversity is a contemporaneous distribution measure.
features.null_policy: Null / insufficient entities before deployment.

features.label: breadth — pct above 50-day MA (long history)
features.description: Market-wide pct_above_50 from breadth/breadth.parquet. Long history to 1962. Used as a cycle health proxy.
features.pit_basis_note: Conservative class for the whole series. The 1962-2001 span is survivorship-biased: sp1500_pit_membership.parquet only covers 2002+, so pre-2002 breadth uses current membership backfilled to historical prices. The post-2002 span qualifies as pit_live via sp1500_pit_membership.parquet, but the whole series is classified recomputed_history to avoid misleading the encoder about pre-2002 data quality.
features.revision_basis: Collected nightly; appended, not revised. But constituent list may change over time.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Pre-2002 breadth uses current-membership survivorship. Post-2002 with PIT membership table is cleaner.
features.null_policy: Null before 1962-03-13. Pre-2002 rows carry survivorship bias; treat with caution.

features.label: sector breadth (2025+)
features.description: Per-sector pct_above_50 and pct_above_200 from sector_breadth.parquet. Captures breadth dispersion across sectors.
features.source_artifact_note: unregistered path — no synapse entry for sector_breadth.parquet as of 2026-07-06
features.pit_basis_note: sector_breadth.parquet only goes back to 2025-05-28 locally. Very short history. This is a structural limitation.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Contemporaneous breadth measure.
features.null_policy: Null before 2025-05-28. Late-start feature. Prefer aggregate breadth (chc_005) for long-history context.

features.label: cycle pattern truth summary
features.description: From cycle_pattern_state.json: truth_summary block capturing how many entities have truths logged and their average truth coverage.
features.pit_basis_note: Snapshot of the truth coverage audit; no historical time series.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Metadata about how many entities have truth annotations; no forward return.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment.

features.label: cycle entity diversity (family distribution)
features.description: Distribution of entity families (bloc/sector/index/ticker) in the live cycle pattern set. Contextual structural feature.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as chc_002.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Structural distribution, no forward information.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment.

features.label: options entry state — aggregate IV and gamma regime
features.description: Aggregated options entry signals: median IV30, IV rank, gamma regime distribution, pin risk share. Context-only aggregation across the 403-name options universe.
features.pit_basis_note: Options data is collected from ThetaData/Polygon; state.parquet is built nightly and is append-only in the options collection pipeline. But local data only shows 2 weeks. Pre-2021 options data is not available (ThetaData coverage).
features.revision_basis: Collected and scored nightly. Append-only by date.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Options market data is contemporaneous. IV and gamma are live market observations.
features.null_policy: Null for dates before options data collection began (approximately 2021 for systematic coverage). The 2-week local window understates actual history; full history is R2-managed.

features.label: options skew snapshots — cross-name skew summary
features.description: Median and distribution of per-name skew from options_skew/snapshots.parquet. Context on whether the options market is pricing tail risk asymmetrically.
features.pit_basis_note: Collected from live options data; append-only. Local 2-week window. Full history R2-managed.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Live market data collection.
features.null_policy: Null before systematic collection (~2021). R2-managed history not accessible locally.

features.label: options IV spread — IV surface term structure
features.description: ATM IV spread by tenor from options_ivspread/snapshots.parquet. Captures the term structure of implied volatility.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as ofb_002. Local 1-week window; R2 holds longer history.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Live market data.
features.null_policy: Null before ~2021 systematic collection.

features.label: GEX state history — index-level gamma exposure
features.description: Per-index (SPY/QQQ/DIA/IWM) net GEX, gamma flip level, gamma regime from index_gex_history/*.parquet. Captures options market-maker positioning context.
features.pit_basis_note: GEX history was reconstructed from historical options data (provenance.reconstructed=true in synapse notes). The reconstruction method applies current GEX calculation code to historical options chains, which may not match what was known in real time.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Reconstructed GEX history using current methodology. Actual GEX levels and flips perceived in real time may differ due to methodology evolution.
features.null_policy: Null before 2017. R2 may hold additional history for the live collection period (post-2021).

features.label: factor weather state
features.description: From world_state.json factor_weather block: style_regime, factor_leader, ratio_iwf_iwd_20d, ratio_qqq_spy_20d. Captures current factor rotation state.
features.pit_basis_note: world_state.json is current snapshot. factor-state-history (data/factordata/factor_state_history.jsonl) is append-only but artifact not present locally. Full history not accessible without R2 or a recomputed_history run.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Ratio-based style measures are contemporaneous; no forward information.
features.null_policy: Null before factor_weather deployment. Use factor-state-history when available.

features.label: dispersion regime
features.description: Dispersion state from data/dispersion/regime.json: state, dispersion_pctile, avg_corr, shadow_gross_mult. Captures current market dispersion context.
features.pit_basis_note: Current-snapshot JSON. No history parquet locally. The dispersion_pctile uses an expanding window from the available history, making it PIT-live going forward but the backfill is a recompute.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Dispersion is a contemporaneous cross-sectional measure.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment. Use history field in the JSON for recent context only.

features.label: bottom sensors — aggregate bottom state distribution
features.description: Distribution of bottom_state and entry_quality_band across the 1,722-name bottom sensor universe. Context-only aggregate — not individual ticker signals.
features.pit_basis_note: Bottom sensors is rebuilt nightly; as_of = 2026-07-02 for the current local file. Only current snapshot available locally. This is a display-only artifact with no long historical series.
features.revision_basis: Rebuilt nightly. No append-only history for the full bottom sensor panel.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Display-only; bottom state classification is based on price and fundamental data observed contemporaneously.
features.null_policy: Null before bottom sensors was deployed. Aggregate distribution only — no individual ticker details.

features.label: options entry gate — gauntlet pass/fail
features.description: Binary pass/fail gate from options entry gauntlet (data/options_entry/gate.json). Captures whether the options entry suite has passed pre-registration criteria.
features.pit_basis_note: Current snapshot JSON. The gate checks the current state of the options entry suite.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Binary metadata about data quality/coverage; no return information.
features.null_policy: Null if gate not yet computed.

features.label: options weather — market-wide vol context
features.description: From world_state.json options_weather block: median_iv30, median_skew, share_skew_rising, opex_days. Context-only cross-name options summary.
features.pit_basis_note: Same as ofb_005 — world_state.json current snapshot only.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Live market data summary.
features.null_policy: Null before deployment (~2021 options data availability).

features.label: fire coordinates — factor intelligence state
features.description: Factor intelligence fire coordinates from data/factordata/fire_coordinates.jsonl. Captures which factor families are currently firing. NOTE: artifact not present locally — may be R2-managed or pending initial build.
features.pit_basis_note: Append-only JSONL per synapse. But file not present locally. Available history unknown.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Append-only PIT record.
features.null_policy: Treat as no active fires if absent. Artifact may be R2-managed or not yet populated.

features._comment: ==== FAMILY 7: STOCK PERSONALITY AND BOARD CONTEXT ====

features.label: archetype distribution across fires
features.description: Distribution of stock archetypes (compounder / turnaround / cyclical / speculative) among active claims in the spine. Day-level aggregate, not individual tickers.
features.pit_basis_note: archetypes/history.parquet is an on-demand rebuild of fundamental archetype assignments using current methodology applied to historical financials. Not a rolling PIT record of what was known at each date.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Current archetype model applied to historical financials may embed methodology not available at the time of original claim fires.
features.null_policy: Null pre-2009. Sparse 2009-2015 for smaller names. Aggregation to day-level archetype distribution degrades for dates with few fires.

features.label: stock personality panel — aggregate cohort summary
features.description: Day-level aggregate of stock personality dimensions (archetype_dominant, dna_class distribution) across the US stock universe. Context-only at cohort level. Panel is R2-managed; local data not available.
features.pit_basis_note: stock-personality-panel is gitignored-local and published to R2. The nightly engine is the sole advancer. PIT-live going forward from first build, but history prior to program launch (~2026) is not available.
features.revision_basis: Nightly engine is sole advancer; append-only ledger.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Stock personality dimensions are computed from contemporaneous price/fundamental data.
features.null_policy: Null before stock-personality program launch (~2026). R2-managed; local access requires R2 credentials.

features.label: DNA class reference distribution
features.description: Distribution of dna_class assignments from site/factordata/dna_class.json. Captures how many stocks fall in each DNA class (momentum/defensive/etc) currently.
features.pit_basis_note: Built nightly from factor panel. Current snapshot; no long history series.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Distribution of contemporaneous classification labels.
features.null_policy: Null before dna_class feature deployment.

features.label: stock personality forward ledger — aggregate by date
features.description: Append-only ledger of daily stock personality snapshots. Tracks how the personality distribution evolves over time.
features.pit_basis_note: Append-only ledger; nightly engine is sole advancer. Not present locally (file missing). Starts from stock-personality program launch.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Append-only PIT record.
features.null_policy: File absent locally. R2 or nightly pipeline required.

features.label: US board claim density by archetype
features.description: Count of us_board engine claims by archetype per date in spine_index. Links spine claim density to stock personality context.
features.pit_basis_note: Archetype stamps in spine come from archetypes-history rebuild (recomputed_history). Same caveats as spb_001.
features.revision_basis: Full rebuild nightly (spine) + on-demand (archetypes). Archetype changes propagate to spine on next rebuild.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Archetype assigned retroactively to historical board fires.
features.null_policy: Null archetype pre-2009. Zero count when no board fires on a date.

features.label: dt_contra_state — bullish/bearish chip distribution
features.description: From dt_contra_state.json: distribution of stock chips across bullish/bearish/neutral bands in the candidate universe. Day-level aggregate context.
features.pit_basis_note: Daily snapshot. No long history. The dt_contra_state reflects current board position distribution.
features.leakage_risk_reason: Count of current board positions; no forward information.
features.null_policy: Null before dt_contra deployment.

era_summary.note: Coverage eras for the era-confound audit per frozen law 4.

pre_2000.era_confound_risk: HIGH — any latent axis built on this era primarily reflects track_record / early breadth / regime patterns with no options, factor, or personality context.

2000_2008.era_confound_risk: HIGH — same structural gap as pre-2000 with slightly more regime context.

2009_2016.era_confound_risk: MEDIUM — spine + regime + some personality context, but no confluence or options.

2017_2020.era_confound_risk: MEDIUM — better coverage but still missing confluence topology and kernel reliability series.

2021_plus.era_confound_risk: LOW for coverage — but only 5 years of full-panel data. Any latent cluster with 2021-2026 dense membership and pre-2021 sparse membership will look like an era detector.
